## Summary\n- require retained clipboard product E2E artifact roles to match the exact required role set\n- reject duplicate retained artifact roles within each clipboard direction\n- cover the new fail-closed behavior with a focused evidence-tool regression test\n\n## Verification\n- PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=tools python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_clipboard_e2e_gate -v\n- make clipboard-e2e-gate CLIPBOARD_E2E_REQUIRE_PASS=\n- make phase0-stable-release-gate PHASE0_STABLE_RELEASE_EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT=2c41ca339e8465c433032251670ff45e86ee3505\n\n## Gate status\nThis is fail-closed evidence tooling hardening only. It does not close the Android/macOS clipboard product E2E gate; missing real Host readiness, transport, and bidirectional product evidence still keep the gate blocked.

<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->

## Summary by CodeRabbit

- **Bug Fixes**
  - Improved retained-artifact validation to reject unknown or duplicate roles.
  - Validation continues to identify missing required roles, helping prevent incomplete or invalid evidence from being accepted.

- **Tests**
  - Added end-to-end coverage for unknown roles, duplicate roles, and missing required roles to improve validation reliability.

title: Require exact clipboard E2E artifact roles
